name: Heat map / Relief
look: A false-colour massif on black, blue shallows to a sand coast, red slopes and a yellow summit, as a perspective mesh in wire of one width; one amber isoline threads round the mountain; pixel-font labels and ruler brackets; plate B is the same surface from above as an isoline map

axes.base: the void: flat black, nothing lit but the surface and the furniture
axes.line: wire of one constant width (1.4 px) over every quad of the mesh, near and far alike; 2 px isolines on plate B
axes.tone: the height ramp: blue shallows, a hard sand coast, red slopes, a yellow summit, with a soft lambert shade per quad
axes.planB: isoline map: the same surface from above, each level in its ramp colour on black, heights on every third level, a faint graticule and a section with its profile
axes.motion: weightless 24: the camera drifts and descends on ones, the thread draws on, the section slides; nothing on twos
axes.accent: the amber thread: one isoline, on the mesh and on the map, nothing else amber
axes.font: monospace: pixelText (5×7) in wire and dim, labels on black knock-outs
axes.match: isoline: the camera lands straight down on the last frame of plate A and the amber thread lies on plate B's isoline
axes.overlays: ruler brackets round the map, a ruler under the title, callouts on leaders, a stepped legend
